errors.evidence: The description claims the categories on the horizontal axis are in alphabetical order, but they are sorted in descending order based on the value of the bars.
The description states that the vertical axis is labeled with numerical values. The axis itself has no numerical labels; the values are shown as data labels above each bar.
The list of positions with a value of 5 is incomplete. It omits the position 'Технически ръководител' (Technical Lead), which also has a value of 5.
The description incorrectly states that the value for 'Вицепрезидент' (Vice President) is 5. The chart clearly shows this value is 4.

The description incorrectly lists 'Директор на отдел' (Department Director) with a value of 4. This category has a value of 5 and was already mentioned earlier in the sentence. The other category with a value of 4 is 'Вицепрезидент' (Vice President).
